command:
set -euo pipefail
root=$(mktemp -d /tmp/fred-omega-reg2.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$root"' EXIT
branch='chatgpt/fred-omega-world-brain-convergence-20260913'
expected='37aed62d3ef3714b278026e5c251403952b7dbf2'
repo="$root/repo"
git clone --quiet --branch "$branch" --single-branch https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/frankenstein.git "$repo"
cd "$repo"
head=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
echo SOURCE_HEAD=$head
[ "$head" = "$expected" ] || { echo HEAD_DRIFT; exit 40; }
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

def replace(path, old, new, count):
    p=Path(path); s=p.read_text(); n=s.count(old)
    if n != count:
        raise SystemExit(f'{path}: expected {count}, got {n} for {old!r}')
    p.write_text(s.replace(old,new))

replace('scripts/omega_world_turn.py',
        'import omega_externalized_cognition as externalized\n',
        'import omega_externalized_cognition as externalized\nimport omega_cognitive_regulation as regulation\n', 1)
replace('scripts/omega_world_turn.py',
        '        cognition = externalized.build_cycle(\n',
        '        cognition = regulation.build_full_cycle(\n', 1)

replace('scripts/install_voice_777_omega.sh',
        '  omega_externalized_cognition.py\n',
        '  omega_externalized_cognition.py\n  omega_externalized_learning.py\n  omega_cognitive_regulation.py\n', 1)

wf='.github/workflows/omega-native-world-model.yml'
replace(wf,
        "      - 'scripts/omega_externalized_cognition.py'\n",
        "      - 'scripts/omega_externalized_cognition.py'\n      - 'scripts/omega_externalized_learning.py'\n      - 'scripts/omega_cognitive_regulation.py'\n", 2)
replace(wf,
        '          scripts/omega_externalized_cognition.py\n',
        '          scripts/omega_externalized_cognition.py\n          scripts/omega_externalized_learning.py\n          scripts/omega_cognitive_regulation.py\n', 1)
replace(wf,
        "      - 'tests/test_omega_externalized_cognition.py'\n",
        "      - 'tests/test_omega_externalized_cognition.py'\n      - 'tests/test_omega_externalized_learning.py'\n      - 'tests/test_omega_cognitive_regulation.py'\n", 2)
replace(wf,
        '          tests/test_omega_externalized_cognition.py\n',
        '          tests/test_omega_externalized_cognition.py\n          tests/test_omega_externalized_learning.py\n          tests/test_omega_cognitive_regulation.py\n', 1)

p=Path('scripts/omega_runtime.py'); s=p.read_text()
anchor='''    "grid": {
        "path": "scripts/f2wp1207_grid10_turn_loop.py",
        "role": "canonical GRID10 transaction/reentry/competition lifecycle",
    },
'''
insert=anchor + '''    "externalized_cognition": {
        "path": "scripts/omega_externalized_cognition.py",
        "role": "typed micro-cognition, persistent cognitive state and context compilation",
    },
    "externalized_learning": {
        "path": "scripts/omega_externalized_learning.py",
        "role": "CEV measurement, matched ablation credit and consolidation readiness",
    },
    "cognitive_regulation": {
        "path": "scripts/omega_cognitive_regulation.py",
        "role": "module/concept ecology, strategy inhibition and manifestation attractor",
    },
'''
if s.count(anchor)!=1: raise SystemExit(f'omega_runtime grid anchor count={s.count(anchor)}')
s=s.replace(anchor,insert)
old='''PURE_COGNITION_ORGANS = (
    "world_state",'''
new='''PURE_COGNITION_ORGANS = (
    "externalized_cognition",
    "externalized_learning",
    "cognitive_regulation",
    "world_state",'''
if s.count(old)!=1: raise SystemExit('PURE_COGNITION anchor mismatch')
s=s.replace(old,new)
old='''        "world_brain_path": [
            "world_state",
            "world_manifold",'''
new='''        "world_brain_path": [
            "world_state",
            "externalized_cognition",
            "cognitive_regulation",
            "world_manifold",'''
if s.count(old)!=1: raise SystemExit('world_brain_path anchor mismatch')
s=s.replace(old,new)
p.write_text(s)
PY
python3 -m py_compile scripts/omega_runtime.py scripts/omega_externalized_cognition.py scripts/omega_externalized_learning.py scripts/omega_cognitive_regulation.py scripts/omega_world_model.py scripts/omega_world_reentry.py scripts/omega_world_coupling.py scripts/omega_world_manifold.py scripts/omega_world_brain_bridge.py scripts/omega_world_hybrid_fusion.py scripts/omega_grf_field.py scripts/omega_grf_brain.py scripts/omega_world_turn.py scripts/omega_voice_world_patch.py scripts/voice_full_runtime.py
python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_omega_runtime.py tests/test_omega_externalized_cognition.py tests/test_omega_externalized_learning.py tests/test_omega_cognitive_regulation.py tests/test_omega_grf_turn_forensics.py tests/test_omega_world_model.py tests/test_omega_world_reentry_coupling.py tests/test_omega_world_donor_frankenstein.py tests/test_omega_world_agentzero_hybrid.py tests/test_omega_world_brain_convergence.py tests/test_omega_grf_field_convergence.py tests/test_omega_world_turn.py tests/test_omega_voice_world_patch_contract.py tests/test_omega_voice_world_patch_semantics.py
git diff --check
git add scripts/omega_world_turn.py scripts/install_voice_777_omega.sh scripts/omega_runtime.py .github/workflows/omega-native-world-model.yml
git commit -m 'FRED: converge externalized cognition through canonical OMEGA runtime'
git push origin HEAD:"$branch"
new_head=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
echo TESTED_PUSHED_HEAD=$new_head

# Materialize only the exact checkout that just passed. Installer is required to leave FINAL policy and process untouched.
dest=$HOME/.local/lib/frankenstein-voice-final
scripts=$dest/scripts
service=frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service
pid_before=$(systemctl --user show "$service" -p MainPID --value 2>/dev/null || true)
final_sha_before=$(sha256sum "$scripts/voice_final_runtime.py" | awk '{print $1}')
exec_before=$(systemctl --user show "$service" -p ExecStart --value 2>/dev/null || true)
./scripts/install_voice_777_omega.sh
pid_after=$(systemctl --user show "$service" -p MainPID --value 2>/dev/null || true)
final_sha_after=$(sha256sum "$scripts/voice_final_runtime.py" | awk '{print $1}')
exec_after=$(systemctl --user show "$service" -p ExecStart --value 2>/dev/null || true)
[ "$pid_before" = "$pid_after" ] || { echo UNEXPECTED_RESTART; exit 50; }
[ "$final_sha_before" = "$final_sha_after" ] || { echo FINAL_POLICY_DRIFT; exit 51; }
[ "$exec_before" = "$exec_after" ] || { echo EXECSTART_DRIFT; exit 52; }
python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib, pathlib
src=pathlib.Path.cwd()/'scripts'
dst=pathlib.Path.home()/'.local/lib/frankenstein-voice-final/scripts'
names=[
'omega_runtime.py','omega_externalized_cognition.py','omega_externalized_learning.py','omega_cognitive_regulation.py',
'omega_world_model.py','omega_world_reentry.py','omega_world_coupling.py','omega_world_manifold.py','omega_world_brain_bridge.py',
'omega_world_hybrid_fusion.py','omega_grf_field.py','omega_grf_brain.py','omega_world_turn.py','omega_voice_world_patch.py','voice_full_runtime.py'
]
for n in names:
    a=(src/n).read_bytes(); b=(dst/n).read_bytes()
    if hashlib.sha256(a).digest()!=hashlib.sha256(b).digest():
        raise SystemExit(f'BYTE_MISMATCH:{n}')
print(f'BYTE_MATCH={len(names)}/{len(names)}')
PY
python3 -m py_compile "$scripts/omega_runtime.py" "$scripts/omega_externalized_cognition.py" "$scripts/omega_externalized_learning.py" "$scripts/omega_cognitive_regulation.py" "$scripts/omega_world_turn.py" "$scripts/omega_voice_world_patch.py" "$scripts/voice_full_runtime.py" "$scripts/voice_final_runtime.py"
$HOME/.local/bin/omega selftest
echo PID_BEFORE=$pid_before
echo PID_AFTER=$pid_after
echo FINAL_SHA=$final_sha_after
echo OMEGA_EXTERNALIZED_REGULATION_MATERIALIZATION_PASS
